# controller: # Source paths are relative to the filesystem root of the selected factory
# image. They are not Android userspace paths and are copied only into the
# Linux firmware-class tree after the explicit extraction confirmation.
# A five-field row ending in `bundle` recursively enumerates the exact
# allow-listed directory. Every extracted regular file gets its own
# destination-aware manifest row with the same relative suffix. Symlinks and
# special files fail closed; an empty required bundle is an error.
